name: Account Switch Information Response V 06
definition: The AccountSwitchInformationResponse message is sent by the account servicer that previously held the account to the new account servicer to signal whether the account owner's account can be switched and to pass details of payment arrangements to be transferred to the new account servicer if the account may be switched. Confirmation of the balance transfer window is permitted by the old account servicer.

AccountSwitchDetails.name: Account Switch Details
AccountSwitchDetails.definition: Contains information about the details of the account switch.

NewAccount.name: New Account
NewAccount.definition: New account to which the switch will be made (destination account).

OldAccount.name: Old Account
OldAccount.definition: Account held at the old account servicer being switched to the new account servicer.

PaymentInstruction.name: Payment Instruction
PaymentInstruction.definition: Details of debit payment arrangements associated with the old account. For example the payment may be a standing order, a bill payment arrangement or a future dated payment.

DirectDebitInstruction.name: Direct Debit Instruction
DirectDebitInstruction.definition: Details of a direct debit instruction associated with the old account.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
